headline: Sensex surges nearly 1,000 points as Indian markets bounce back led by banking and auto stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Banking and auto stocks drove a strong market rally, pushing Bank Nifty to a record high.
Nifty reclaimed the 25,500 mark for the first time since February while Sensex reclaimed 83,000.
SEBI announced a roadmap focused on faster IPOs and easier access for foreign investors.
Markets recovered strongly despite early gap-down signals and Fed rate hike concerns.
whatHappening: Sensex surged nearly 1,000 points while Nifty crossed 25,500 led by auto and bank shares.
Bank Nifty hit a record high during today's market surge.
IT and metal stocks experienced selling pressure earlier in the trading session.
SEBI outlined measures to speed up IPO approvals and ease foreign investment procedures.
summary: Indian share markets experienced a massive rally as Sensex surged nearly 1,000 points and Nifty reclaimed the 25,500 level. The gains were driven by strong buying in banking and auto stocks, sending Bank Nifty to a record high. Additionally, SEBI unveiled plans for faster IPOs and easier foreign investor entry.
